name: PDEBench
description: A benchmark suite of scientific machine-learning datasets for learning solutions to partial differential equations, including diverse physical systems, equations, and simulation settings.
citation: Takamoto, M., Praditia, T., Bonev, B., et al. (2022). PDEBench: An Extensive Benchmark for Scientific Machine Learning. Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 35, Datasets and Benchmarks Track. https://arxiv.org/abs/2210.07182

license.notes: PDEBench aggregates data from multiple sources with differing terms; there is no single standard SPDX license identifier applicable to the complete collection. Review the license and attribution requirements for each dataset before use or redistribution.
